# patientdesk-sdk

> Unofficial TypeScript SDK for PatientDesk Turkish voice models. Alania text-to-speech, Duyu speech-to-text over REST and WebSocket, and a keyless status helper. Zero runtime dependencies.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://groophylifefor.github.io/patientdesk-sdk/docs/getting-started.md)

- [Text to speech](https://groophylifefor.github.io/patientdesk-sdk/docs/text-to-speech.md)

- [Streaming](https://groophylifefor.github.io/patientdesk-sdk/docs/streaming.md)
- [Node.js recipes](https://groophylifefor.github.io/patientdesk-sdk/docs/recipes.md)
